name: The Seeing Stone
description: Surveillance: warns you a day before every raid, raiders arrive 20% weaker, and fraud forms are flagged in the S.E.C. audit. It sees everything. It has opinions about your spending. A legendary Stock Bag from BUNKR, bought with tokenized PLTR on Robinhood Chain plus a $BUNKR burn. Bring it into any run: it never shatters.
